title: The constructible topology of a topological space
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space. The *constructible topology* on the set $X$ is the topology generated by the subbase consisting of the quasi-compact open subsets $U\subseteq X$ and their complements $X\setminus U$ (equivalently: the subsets that are open and quasi-compact, and the subsets that are closed with quasi-compact complement). It is the coarsest topology on $X$ in which every quasi-compact open subset of $X$ is both open and closed. When $X$ is a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space] it is also called the patch topology.
